Device APIs

Protobuf messages sent by devices over HTTP. See the HTTP API docs for routes, status codes, and upload behavior, or download the protobuf definition.

The Label column describes protobuf wire presence. Server-required fields and validation limits are documented in each field’s description.

DevicePlayerAffiliation

One current player assignment. Categories and affiliations belong to the

player's event. UUIDs use the 16-byte representation and names use the PDN

display profile described in DevicePlayerResponse. Use UUIDs for identity.

FieldTypeLabelDescription
category_id bytes

Category UUID.

category_name string

Current category name, such as Allegiance or Faction.

affiliation_id bytes

Affiliation UUID within this category.

affiliation_name string

Current affiliation name, such as Helix Industries.

DevicePlayerResponse

Response for GET /device/players/by-pin/{pin}, application/protobuf.

No request body. The path PIN is exactly four ASCII digits, including leading

zeros, and is resolved in the active event. Invalid PIN format returns 400;

no active event or no matching player returns 404. Errors are plain text.

Includes inactive registrations, without exposing their status. Email, PIN,

event ID, creation time, and active status are not part of this response.

Current PDN display profile: control characters become ?, then display strings

are transliterated to ASCII. Unknown characters and any remaining non-printable

output become ?. The result is truncated to 255 bytes. Only printable ASCII

(0x20-0x7E) is sent; no null terminator is sent.

Stored names are unchanged. Display text may be empty or collide after conversion;

use UUIDs for identity. Firmware using C strings needs room for a terminator.

UUIDs are exactly 16 bytes in RFC 9562 network byte order: the byte pairs of

the canonical hexadecimal UUID, with hyphens removed (not little-endian GUIDs).

FieldTypeLabelDescription
id bytes

Player UUID. Stable for this registration.

name string

Current player display name, using the PDN display profile above.

team_id bytes optional

Current team UUID, absent when unassigned. Not a match-time snapshot.

team_name string optional

Current team name using the PDN display profile; absent when unassigned.

affiliations DevicePlayerAffiliation repeated

Current assignments in categories with send_to_devices=true, ordered by the original category name then category UUID. At most one affiliation per category. Unassigned and disabled categories are omitted. May be empty; there is no fixed count limit. Names reflect current renames and use the PDN display profile. These are membership details, not permissions or match-time scoring snapshots.

QuickdrawMatch

FieldTypeLabelDescription
id string

Required UUID strings. Both devices must use the same shared match ID.

player_a_id string

Required first participant's player UUID.

player_b_id string

Required second participant's player UUID; must differ from player_a_id.

player_a_team_id string optional

Match-time snapshots supplied by the devices, not current membership. Omit for an unassigned player; a present value must be a valid team UUID.

player_b_team_id string optional

Second participant's team UUID at match time. Omit for an unassigned player.

player_a_draw_time_ms uint64 optional

Required despite proto3 optional: zero is valid, absence is not. Must fit a signed 64-bit integer (maximum 9223372036854775807).

player_b_draw_time_ms uint64 optional

Second participant's unsigned draw time in milliseconds. Required; zero is valid. Must fit a signed 64-bit integer (maximum 9223372036854775807).

winner_player_id string

Required participant UUID. The server does not infer the winner from times.

occurred_at_unix_ms int64 optional

Required UTC milliseconds since 1970-01-01; nonnegative, through year 9999. Maximum 253402300799999. The first accepted upload supplies the timestamp and all other fields.

QuickdrawMatchRejection

First detected error for one match. Fixing it may reveal another error.

FieldTypeLabelDescription
match_index uint32

Zero-based request position. Use this to identify the entry; IDs may repeat.

match_id string

Exact submitted ID, including an empty or malformed value when invalid.

fields string repeated

QuickdrawMatch field names. SAME_PLAYER includes both participant ID fields.

code QuickdrawMatchErrorCode

Stable machine-readable reason. Clients must handle unknown future codes.

WriteDeviceLogRequest

Request body for POST /device-logs.

The server generates:

- id

- received_at

FieldTypeLabelDescription
device_mac string optional

Required by the server. Colon-separated 48-bit address, such as "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff".

crash_number uint64 optional

Required by the server. Device-assigned crash report number. Zero is valid. Must fit a signed 64-bit integer (maximum 9223372036854775807).

uptime_ms uint64 optional

Required by the server. Milliseconds since the device booted. Zero is valid. Must fit a signed 64-bit integer (maximum 9223372036854775807).

software_version string optional

Firmware/software build identifier.

reset_reason uint32 optional

Required by the server. Raw numeric reset-reason code reported by the device. Must fit a signed 32-bit integer (maximum 2147483647). Zero is valid.

program_counter fixed32 optional

Address of the instruction being executed when the exception occurred.

exception_cause uint32 optional

Raw numeric exception-cause code.

task_name string optional

FreeRTOS task active when the exception occurred.

WriteQuickdrawMatchesRequest

POST /quickdraw-matches, application/protobuf.

Upload completed matches for the active event. 204 means all entries were

accepted; 200 returns WriteQuickdrawMatchesResponse with rejected entries.

See the HTTP API docs for request-wide errors and scoring behavior.

FieldTypeLabelDescription
matches QuickdrawMatch repeated

Required batch of 1-100 completed matches. Maximum encoded request body: 256 KiB.

WriteQuickdrawMatchesResponse

Response body for HTTP 200 from POST /quickdraw-matches, application/protobuf.

Retrying the same IDs is safe: the first accepted report is never overwritten.

FieldTypeLabelDescription
rejected QuickdrawMatchRejection repeated

One rejection per failed entry, in request order; may include every entry. Entries not listed were saved or already stored.

QuickdrawMatchErrorCode

Reasons for rejecting an individual match.

NameNumberDescription
QUICKDRAW_MATCH_ERROR_CODE_UNSPECIFIED 0

Unspecified/default value; never emitted by the server.
QUICKDRAW_MATCH_ERROR_CODE_INVALID_UUID 1

A required UUID is missing/malformed, or a present optional UUID is malformed.
QUICKDRAW_MATCH_ERROR_CODE_MISSING_FIELD 2

A required draw time or occurrence timestamp is absent.
QUICKDRAW_MATCH_ERROR_CODE_OUT_OF_RANGE 3

A measurement or timestamp is outside its documented numeric range.
QUICKDRAW_MATCH_ERROR_CODE_SAME_PLAYER 4

Both participant UUIDs are equal.
QUICKDRAW_MATCH_ERROR_CODE_INVALID_WINNER 5

The winner UUID is neither participant.
QUICKDRAW_MATCH_ERROR_CODE_INVALID_EVENT_REFERENCE 6

A player/team ID is unknown or belongs to another event.
